newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn urges Germans to quit Albania.
newsitem.headline: Bonn urges Germans to quit Albania.

text.p: Germany on Wednesday urged its nationals living in Albania to leave the country and advised any would-be travellers planning to visit the country to stay away.
Foreign ministry spokesman Horst Freitag told the government's regular news conference that there were between 140 and 160 Germans in Albania.
"All Germans who are in Albania should leave if at all possible," Freitag said.
A state of emergency and nationwide curfew came into force throughout Albania on Monday as parliament elected President Sali Berisha to a second five-year term in office.
The election took place a day after the parliament voted unanimously to declare an immediate state of emergency in response to armed unrest in the south of the Balkan country.
